accountabilityFindings.finding: Combined total estimates increased by $49.3 billion for 30 major defense acquisition programs also included in the prior assessment.

accountabilityFindings.finding: Planned investment in costliest weapon programs

accountabilityFindings.label: Average initial-capability schedule
accountabilityFindings.finding: Expected time for MDAPs to provide an initial capability increased by 18 months to almost 12 years from program start.

accountabilityFindings.label: Sentinel estimate growth concentration
accountabilityFindings.finding: GAO reported that the Air Force Sentinel missile program accounted for more than $36 billion, or 73 percent, of the $49.3 billion portfolio increase.
